content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WAPCOS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WAPCOS Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the WAPCOS Young Professional recruitment is 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 37 vacancies for the Young Professional posts in WAPCOS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional (Legal) post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional (Legal) post, candidates must possess an LL.B. degree from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Young Professional posts is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 50,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this WAPCOS recruitment is Offline.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the WAPCOS Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the WAPCOS Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the WAPCOS Young Professional posts will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Water and Power Consultancy Services (WAPCOS) is conducting this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The job location for these posts is Gurugram, Haryana.
